reden: Yes. The audit’s first High issue explicitly identifies that Guard.sol does not block setFallbackHandler(address), allowing the renter to set the Safe’s fallback handler to the rented NFT contract so unknown calls (e.g., transferFrom/safeTransferFrom) are forwarded with msg.sender == the Safe, bypassing the guard and enabling theft of ERC721/1155. This is the same mechanism, code path (Guard.checkTransaction/_checkTransaction and setFallbackHandler in the Safe), attack flow, and impact described in the vulnerability description. Adding a guard check to block or constrain setFallbackHandler would fix both.
